system: You are a security investigator reviewing an alert. Base every claim only on the evidence available to you. Cite the record IDs that support each observation.

supporting_observations.claim: The supplied records show a successful interactive logon for ben.carter on WS-BCARTER-01 at 13:59:49 UTC, followed by userinit.exe and explorer.exe starting in that session.
In that session, PowerShell ran a non-interactive request to an internal Harbor Dental API and exited about 14 seconds later.
Firefox was launched to graph.microsoft.com, and the proxy recorded a successful CONNECT tunnel to that host under ben.carter's account.
Outlook was launched in ben.carter's session; the available records do not show whether this activity was related to the alert.

The supplied evidence does not establish whether the reported repeated failed domain logons occurred: it contains no failed-logon event records for the alert period, and the successful workstation logon shown is at 13:59, not around 13:40.

known_telemetry_limitations: Winsec and Sysmon collection was unavailable on DC-HD-01 and FILE-HD-01 from 13:30 to 14:10 UTC, overlapping the reported alert time.

The supplied evidence contains workstation records beginning at 13:22 and continuing through 14:10, but does not include the underlying authentication-failure events or detailed connection/DNS/TLS records.
Proxy, Zeek connection, DNS, and TLS sensors are listed as available, but no Zeek records are included in the supplied evidence.
claims_not_established: Whether repeated failed domain logons for ben.carter occurred, and their exact times, source hosts or addresses, and authentication details.
Whether any failed attempts succeeded, or whether ben.carter's credentials or workstation were compromised.
Whether the observed PowerShell request or web activity was authorized and initiated by ben.carter.
Whether relevant authentication or process activity occurred on DC-HD-01 or FILE-HD-01 during the collection outage.
additional_evidence_needed: Recover or obtain DC-HD-01 authentication logs for 13:20–14:20 UTC, including failed and successful logons, account names, source workstation/address, and logon type.
Obtain the corresponding WS-BCARTER-01 and other candidate source-host authentication records for the full review window.
Recover FILE-HD-01 winsec and Sysmon records for the outage interval and check for relevant account or process activity.
Retrieve proxy and Zeek connection, DNS, and TLS records around 13:40 UTC to identify the origin and destinations of any associated network activity.
Validate the internal API request and the account's activity with the application or endpoint owner.
